entities.name: José Luis Bueno
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Bueno is a Mexican former professional boxer and former WBC and Lineal Super Flyweight Champion. Bueno was also the trainer of former WBC Light Flyweight Champion, Adrián Hernández.
